==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|bĕt}}, {{IPA|en|/bɛt/}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-bet.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛt|s=1}}

===Etymology 1===
From 16th-century criminal slang, perhaps from {{inh|en|enm|bet|t=something better, advantage, luck}}, from {{inh|en|ang|bet}}, {{m|enm|bett|t=better|pos=adverb}}; or, alternatively from {{m|en|abet}}, from {{inh|en|enm|abet}}, {{m|enm|abette}}, from {{der|en|fro|abet|t=incitement to evil}}, from {{der|en|fro|abeter|t=to entice}}, from {{m|fro|a-||to}} + {{m|fro|beter|t=hound on, urge, to bait}}; ultimately from {{der|en|gmw-pro|*baitijan|t=to bait, entice}}, related to {{cog|ang|bǣtan|t=to bait}}. More at {{l|en|abet}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|wager}} A [[wager]], an agreement between two parties that a stake (usually money) will be paid by the loser to the winner (the winner being the one who correctly forecast the outcome of an event).
#: {{ux|en|Dylan owes Fletcher $30 from an unsuccessful '''bet'''.}}
# {{lb|en|Philippines|figuratively|informal}} A [[candidate]] (for [[election]]s and [[pageant]]s) or [[competitor]] (in multinational sports).
# {{n-g|Indicating a [[degree]] of [[certainty]], or that something can be relied upon.}}
#: {{ux|en|It’s a safe '''bet''' that it will rain tomorrow.}}
#: {{ux|en|There's a decent '''bet''' that we'll be able to reach the top of that hill in an hour.}}
#: {{ux|en|It’s an even '''bet''' that Jim will come top of the maths test tomorrow.}}
#: {{ux|en|There's a good '''bet''' that Sally will arrive later.}}

====Verb====
{{en-verb|bet<,,~:+>}}

# {{lb|en|transitive|ditransitive}} To [[stake]] or [[pledge]] upon the outcome of an event; to [[wager]].
#: {{ux|en|I('ll) '''bet''' I can run faster than you.}}
#: {{ux|en|I '''bet''' you dinner at the Ritz that you can't run faster than me.}}
#: {{ux|en|I '''bet'''(ted) her £5 it wouldn't rain all week.}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Henry 4-2|III|ii|passage=John a Gaunt loved him well, and '''betted''' much money on his head.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1858|author=w:Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.|title=The Deacon's Masterpiece or The Wonderful One-Hoss Shay
|passage=I'll '''bet''' you two to one I'll make him do it.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To be [[sure]] of something; to be able to [[count on]] something.
#: {{ux|en|Fancy going for a drink after work? / You '''bet''' I do!}}
# {{lb|en|poker}} To place money into the [[pot]] in order to require others do the same, usually only used for the first person to place money in the pot on each round.

====Interjection====
{{en-intj}} {{tlb|en|AAVE|informal|chiefly|North America}}

# {{n-g|Expression of general [[agreement]] or [[acceptance]].}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2008-11-05|magazine=S.O.U.LMag|issue=13|page=66|pageurl=https://issuu.com/soulmag/docs/soulmag_13
|text=He asked if KRS could come by and meet up with a few of us there on Monday night, as he wanted to show him the church and have me build with him. Aight, '''bet'''.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-09-16|date_published=2013-09-12|newspaper=Insight News|volume=40|issue=38|page=6|pageurl=https://issuu.com/insightnews/docs/091613insightnews
|text=Then I rocked the Kansas show and after Jay said, ‘Look, if you want, you can go on tour with us and open and close the shows, but we can’t pay you, but we’ll make sure you get the exposure.’ So I said '''bet''' {{...}}}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2017-11-06|date_published=2017-11-04|newspaper=The DePaulia|location=DePaul University|volume=102|issue=8|page=20|pageurl=https://issuu.com/depauliaonline/docs/nov_6_issue_final
|text=She texted Jimenez and told him it was a nice time, but she wasn’t feeling him and apologized. “'''Bet''',” Jimenez replied, because she kind of pissed him off with that comment.}}
# {{n-g|Exclamation indicating [[acceptance]] of a [[challenge]] or an [[absurd]] proposal.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2018-09-04|newspaper=The Rice Thresher|location=Rice University|volume=103|issue=3|page=9|pageurl=https://issuu.com/thresher/docs/180905thresh
|text=What you may not have stopped to consider is that Big Clit Energy (here referred to as B.C.E.) has been around since... BCE! Eve? She looked sin in the eye and said, “'''Bet'''.”}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2019-04-30|magazine=Key Magazine|publisher=BG Falcon Media|location=Bowling Green State University|page=26|pageurl=https://issuu.com/bgviews/docs/key_-_2019_spring
|text=“(Drummer Brenden Accettura) texted me that and was like, ‘Should we name our band The Hot Mess Express?’ and I said, ‘'''Bet'''.’ So now that’s our name,” Abbie said, getting words out between laughs.}}
# {{n-g|Exclamation of [[joy]] at [[good fortune]].}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2019-05-31|magazine=CopyWrite Magazine|issue=14|page=43|url=https://issuu.com/copywritemagazine/docs/issue14_final_web6_1_19_2
|text=I started making jokes about him feeling like tough sh*t after that presentation haha. Everyone at school geeked his head up [inflated his ego]. He probably got two fruit cups from the lunch lady that day and said, “'''Bet!''' I’m gonna keep doing this!”}}
